newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast gasoline prices ease late on impasse.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast gasoline prices ease late on impasse.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot gasoline prices eased late Thursday amid a trade stalemate which saw sellers trying talk the market up and buyers stepping out.
Few deals closed late as traders watchedthe sharp rise in NYMEX January gasoline and heating oil.
January unleaded gasoline finished 1.16 cents a gallon higher at 64.72 cents, while heating oil ended daytime trade up 1.85 cents a gallon at 68.67 cents.
Unocal on Thursday said a hydrocracker was shut over the weekend at its 130,000 barrel per day Los Angeles-area refinery, which produces 75,000 barrels per day of gasoline.
Traders said by late Thursday the market had absorbed the effects of the outage.
Conventional gasoline in Los Angeles, which firmed 0.50 cents a gallon early, eased to Wednesday levels of 67/68 cents late Thursday.
Low sulphur diesel in L.A., which rose a penny early, shed half that to end 67/67.50 cents.
CARB gasoline saw bids drop two cents to 67 cents, as buyers cited lower rack prices to justify their claims, while offers eased a cent to 71 cents.
Shell said Thursday a new coker, which came into service at its San Francisco-area refinery in late November, ran at full rates. The company declined to give the unit's size or output.
